newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: CMS to invest $200 mln in Argentine power.
newsitem.headline: CMS to invest $200 mln in Argentine power.

text.p: An Argentine subsidiary of U.S. firm CMS Energy Corp will invest $200 million to more than double its electricity generation capacity, the state-run Telam news agency reported Thursday.
Central Termica Mendoza will install a new gas turbine in its plant in the western Argentine province of Mendoza, Telam said, quoting CMS Energy president Victor Fryling.
No CMS official in Argentina was immediately available for comment.
Other ventures by CMS in Argentina include a $700 million joint-venture with Canada's NOVA Corp to build a natural gas pipeline to northern Chile and a gas-fired power plant.
CMS also owns 100 percent of the 128 MW La Plata cogeneration project and leads a consortium which took control of Entre Rios province electricity distributor EDEER in May for $160 million.
